- When sentiment is high (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a sharp price spike, model often overshoots and fails to correct — cap forecast peak at 1–2 days after spike.
- If sentiment is low (≤0.33) and price is falling, model underestimates drop — adjust downward by 1–3% of recent range.
- Model consistently overpredicts mid-term (10–20 day) prices when sentiment is mixed — apply mean reversion bias toward 3–5 day average.
- If sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish within 3 days, model fails to adjust — reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 5 days.
- For 30-day horizon, model often overestimates late period (days 20–30) — cap forecast at 1–2% below recent 10-day average.
